name: boj_get_money_supply
description:
Japanese money stock (M1, M2 or M3, monthly, national currency) from FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis, IMF and OECD series).
Returns: series_code (FRED id), series_id, label, source, observation_count and observations (date, value) oldest first, missing values dropped.
Inputs (* required): aggregate* (m1, m2, m3; schema default m2); start_date, end_date (YYYY-MM-DD); recent_periods (1-100; the last N observations, with no dates looking back N x 45 days; when omitted the whole history in the date range is returned).
For prices use boj_get_inflation; all series: boj_list_series. Needs a FRED API key (FRED_API_KEY, config fred.api.key); without one the call fails with a message saying so.
Example: {"aggregate": "m2", "start_date": "2020-01-01", "end_date": "2024-12-31"}
